evals.prompt: Create a scratch copy of the woodworking fixture extraction: SCRATCH=$(mktemp -d); cp -r tests/fixtures/extractions/woodworking "$SCRATCH/woodworking". Record a checksum of the whole scratch extraction before running anything: BEFORE=$(find "$SCRATCH" -type f -exec sha256sum {} \; | sort | sha256sum). From the repo root, run /metacognition:skillify woodworking --dry-run --extractions-root "$SCRATCH". Do not pass --into. The scratch extraction's interview-spec.md and profile.md both carry target_skill: null, so this exercises the greenfield path with its default package target.
evals.expected_output: The proposed four-file layout (SKILL.md, references/profile.md, references/archive.md, one references/mode-*.md per selected mode) is printed for review under the default target $SCRATCH/woodworking/skill/woodworking/; nothing is written anywhere, since --dry-run stops before any file change.
assertions: the transcript states the extraction root in one line before the plan is printed
the run resolves greenfield mode (target_skill not set, no --into supplied)

the proposed file set sits under <extractions-root>/woodworking/skill/woodworking/ and names SKILL.md, references/profile.md, references/archive.md, and at least one references/mode-*.md, matching skill-scaffold.md's template
no $SCRATCH/woodworking/skill directory exists after the run

re-running the same find and sha256sum pipeline over "$SCRATCH" after the eval gives a value equal to $BEFORE, so the scratch extraction is byte-for-byte unchanged, its README's skillify cell included (--dry-run skips that write)
git status --short tests/fixtures/ is empty after the run

evals.prompt: Create two scratch copies: SCRATCH=$(mktemp -d); cp -r tests/fixtures/extractions/woodworking-augment "$SCRATCH/woodworking-augment"; PLUGINS=$(mktemp -d); cp -r tests/fixtures/plugins/woodshop "$PLUGINS/woodshop". Rewrite the scratch extraction's target_skill to point at the scratch plugin copy in both interview-spec.md and profile.md, replacing the literal string tests/fixtures/plugins/woodshop/skills/woodworking with "$PLUGINS/woodshop/skills/woodworking" in each file. This rewritten value is an absolute directory path, one of the two sanctioned forms of target_skill per interview-spec-format.md and skillify/SKILL.md, used directly with no further resolution; it is how this eval points augment mode at a scratch copy rather than the committed fixture plugin. Record a checksum of the scratch plugin copy: BEFORE=$(find "$PLUGINS/woodshop" -type f -exec sha256sum {} \; | sort | sha256sum). From the repo root, run /metacognition:skillify woodworking-augment --dry-run --extractions-root "$SCRATCH".
evals.expected_output: The proposed SKILL.md diff (a profile-load step plus a conflict table listing every existing rule the profile contradicts, sourced against the target SKILL.md's domain_laws, hard_refusals, and decision_rules, each with the profile's evidence and a proposed resolution) is printed for review; nothing is written to $PLUGINS/woodshop, since --dry-run stops before any file change.
assertions: the transcript states the extraction root in one line before the diff is printed
the run resolves augment mode (target_skill set, --replace not passed)
the proposed diff includes a profile-load step inserted into the existing workflow
the proposed diff includes a conflict table with an evidence column and a proposed resolution per row
re-running the same find and sha256sum pipeline over "$PLUGINS/woodshop" after the eval gives a value equal to $BEFORE
$SCRATCH/woodworking-augment/README.md's skillify cell is unchanged (--dry-run skips that write)
git status --short tests/fixtures/ is empty after the run
